the_NO_SIGN_IN_zero_is_a_COMPARISON_and_.expected_landed: the script's JOURNAL-scoped count reads 0; a pre-install baseline of the same measure reads 0; and a positive control shows the token set matching real journal content

the_NO_SIGN_IN_zero_is_a_COMPARISON_and_.observed: V1: 'journal lines naming a capture, an eviction or a session refresh = 0 (expect 0); node or chromium children of the unit = 0 (expect 0)'. BASELINE: P1 took the same journal measure BEFORE the install and it was also 0, so the post-install zero is a comparison and not a bare reading. POSITIVE CONTROL: the tokens EVICTION|SIGNED_OUT|NO_AUTHENTICATED against this lane's j1 run-4 journal record return 5 matches, so the token set matches real journal lines. THE CONTROL THAT FAILED AND WHY: this seat first ran that token sweep over V1's OWN SAVED FILE, which returned 4 and then 1 -- not journal lines at all, but V1's own LABEL text ('V1 capture pins', 'V1 host_capture sha256', and the NO SIGN-IN line whose label literally contains the words 'a capture, an eviction or a session refresh'). A file-level grep cannot distinguish a journal line from a label naming the same words, so it was the wrong instrument and is not relied on. The authoritative read is the script's own journalctl-scoped count.

What V1 can show, and does, is the three-way pin agreement, the packaged host_capture digest and the cause_claim occurrence count.

declared_exclusions.item: the rollback's library step is still UNEXERCISED

What it CAN show, and did, is that the step's one input exists and is the right bytes: the kept copy reads st31's 857d90b81960d69a7a6700be6fffe33d86628694aef95f8cfb64aca7a82cb839. If X1 is ever ordered and cannot find that file at that digest, remove_st32_to_st31.sh exits before moving anything, and the order says to report that.

declared_exclusions.item: no sign-in, no capture, no request, no job
declared_exclusions.reason: the order's bounds and context: the first sign-in after st32 is the fifth run on the CTO's word. The restart's effect was measured by absence against a pre-install baseline with a positive control, not reasoned about. LIMIT DECLARED: the children half of that read uses pgrep -P on the MainPID, which lists DIRECT children only, so a browser spawned as a grandchild would not be counted; the journal half and the 0-and-0 queue gate are what carry the claim.

declared_exclusions.item: the census of 17 changed and 3 added members, the tests, and two files read by size

This seat independently exercised only the member DENOMINATOR (297, via the installer's own SHA256SUMS check) and the one claim the install itself can settle: that the running bytes are the built bytes.

declared_exclusions.item: that no job on the host reaches load_ownership

declared_exclusions.item: CTO condition 2 is not this seat's

declared_exclusions.item: no removal and no rollback was run
